# Eben Thurston

> Eben Thurston is a New York–based search marketing executive specializing in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). He is Director of Search Marketing (SEO + SEM) and Head of AI Search Strategy at TIAA, a $1.4T+ asset management organization, and has led enterprise search programs since 2000 at companies including Shutterstock, Time Inc., and FULLBEAUTY Brands.

All pages on this site are pre-rendered static HTML; the markup you fetch is complete.
